text:
dylan: incident-bot paged me for high ephemeral usage on gpu pool-3, pods being evicted. seeing repeated model-cache OOMs and a couple of containers crashing with CUDA init errors.
incident-bot: [ALERT] node/gpu-3b ephemeral_storage.available < 5% (trigger: ephemeral_storage_threshold) — 3897654321

maria: thanks for flagging. can someone grab node metrics + df -h? i want to know whether this is tmpfs or local-ssd.
kevin: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --field-selector=spec.nodeName=gpu-3b` shows lots of modelcache pods in CrashLoopBackOff and several evicted: `Reason: Evicted`
kevin: df output from node:```
Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/nvme0n1p1  900G  860G   10G  99% /var/lib/kubelet/pods
tmpfs            32G   29G  3G   91% /dev/shm
```

ben: that's the model-cache dir filling up: /var/lib/kubelet/pods/.../volumes/kubernetes.io~empty-dir/model-cache -> growing fast. think one of the config jobs started regex logging into /tmp inside containers and not rotating.
sophie: i can confirm logs in /tmp/modelcache/ are huge. `du -sh /var/lib/kubelet/pods/*/volumes/*/modelcache` shows a few dirs at 200GB+.

carla: customer-support reported 503s to a few hosted customers; rate of 5xxs spiked around 2026-03-14T18:12: server-side model runtime crashes.
customer-support: we have 3 customers on Dedicated complaining about failed inferences; not widespread but enough to escalate.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) stop log generator processes inside offending pods 2) free up space on node via targeted `find` cleanup 3) cordon node and rebalance pods 4) scale up a replacement node if needed. need oncall to accept handoff.

kevin: running a safe delete:```
sudo find /var/lib/kubelet/pods -type f -path "*/modelcache/tmp/*" -mtime +1 -delete
```
kevin: cleaned ~300GB from /var/lib/kubelet/pods/*/volumes/*/modelcache/tmp within 4m. freed ~15% on node.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] node/gpu-3b freed 320Gi, ephemeral_storage.available now 24%.

ben: i've paused the modelcache workers on affected ReplicaSets (scale down 0 -> 1 restart) to prevent immediate refill. also pushed a temporary cron to delete files older than 2h in the modelcache tmp dir.
sophie: pushed a quick fix to dockerfile for the affected image: change `TMPDIR` to /tmp/modelcache and add `logrotate` config. will follow up with proper image patch. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/patch/1421

maria: are there any pods still throwing CUDA errors? those often mean the container's state is corrupted after evict/recreate. please paste the last few lines of the runtime logs.
kevin: sample from pod inference-worker-56:```
I0321 18:14:22.123 1 model_cache.cc:452] loading shard 3
E0321 18:14:23.456 1 runtime.cc:98] cudaErrorIllegalAddress: an illegal memory access was encountered
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
*** Aborted at 1647326063 (unix time)***
Backtrace: ...
```

carla: that matches customer 42's trace. they've retried and saw consistent failures until pod came back up.

ben: i'm taking oncall from here — ben is primary. i'll coordinate with infra to cordon and reprovision node. @kevin please hand over logs and commands you ran.
ben: cordoning node gpu-3b now: `kubectl cordon gpu-3b`
incident-bot: [ACTION] Node gpu-3b cordoned by ben — 3897654342

ben: draining non-critical pods and evicting remaining modelcache deployments to force scheduling elsewhere: `kubectl drain gpu-3b --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data=false` (we'll handle modelcache volumes before eviction).
kevin: note: `--delete-emptydir-data=false` will leave data but pods will be recreated on other nodes; we prefer to clear modelcache tmp prior to eviction to avoid copying 200GB artifacts.
sophie: spinning up replacement node pool capacity +2 in us-west-2 to absorb load.

maria: short-term customer impact: 503 spike for ~9 minutes, affected customers: 3 Dedicated accounts, ~12k requests failed, no PII exposed. action items: post-incident analysis to include why logrotate wasn't present, add monitoring for emptyDir growth per pod, and a hard quota alert.

carla: documenting for oncall handoff: steps taken, commands, freed 320Gi, cordoned node, scaled up +2 nodes, paused modelcache workers, applied temp cleanup cron. will create incident ticket/inc-389765.

ben: handing back to dylan for follow-up on longer-term fixes (logrotate, TMP limits, per-container emptyDir quotas). i will remain paged for 1h.
dylan: thanks all. filing RCA stub and adding evals team to verify model behavior after restarts.

incident-bot: [RESOLVE] Pager cleared — storage pressure alleviated, active evictions stopped — 3897654399

maria: follow-ups assigned:
- infra: enforce node-level tmpfs caps +-monitoring (owner: kevin)
- runtime: add emptyDir size metric per pod + alert (owner: sophie)
- images: bake logrotate into modelcache image and default TMPDIR (owner: carla)
- docs: playbook for modelcache eviction and safe cleanup (owner: dylan)

carla: i'll notify the affected customers with a summary and mitigations; will include temporary workarounds for Dedicated tenants.

kevin: saving logs to GCS: `gsutil cp /var/log/nodes/gpu-3b/* gs://redwood-incident-logs/389765/`

sophie: adding follow-up todo: run load test to validate that cleanup cron doesn't trigger false positives.

dylan: closing thread for now, will reopen if evictions reoccur. :thumbsup:
